character_plans.description: One entry per INPUT character that needs at least one variant. Characters that need nothing are simply omitted — an empty array is a valid, common result.

character_key.description: Must match one of the input roster's character_key values exactly.

variant_label.description: Short label for this look, e.g. "ชุดนักเรียน" or "วัยเด็ก".

variant_type.description: "outfit" = same age/face, only hair/clothing/makeup differ. "age_stage" = same identity, face allowed to change naturally with age (loose reference to the parent, never a hard lock).

description.description: Concrete visual description of THIS look only (not the character's whole identity).

existing_character_key.description: Set ONLY when you recognize this variant as the SAME one an input roster entry's existing_parent_character_key/existing_variant_label already describes — echo that roster entry's own character_key here instead of proposing a fresh-sounding duplicate. Omit when there is no such overlap.

twin_detections.description: One entry per twin/lookalike GROUP the story explicitly establishes. Empty when the season never establishes twins.

description.description: Short note on how/where the story establishes this twin group.

source_character_key.description: The ALREADY-EXISTING roster character who is this twin group's face source. Must match one of the input roster's character_key values exactly.

new_characters.description: The OTHER sibling(s) not yet in the roster — one entry per new sibling (1 for a pair, 2 for triplets, 3 for quadruplets).

character_key_suggestion.description: Optional suggested character_key for the new row; the calling app deduplicates/finalizes it.

shares_face_with.description: Set to the EXACT SAME value as source_character_key ONLY for an IDENTICAL twin (face reference reused at a hard lock). Omit/null for a FRATERNAL sibling (independent appearance, no face sharing).

distinguishing_notes.description: Concrete details that keep this sibling visually distinct from the source. Required in practice whenever shares_face_with is set.

existing_character_key.description: Set ONLY when you recognize this sibling as the SAME one an input roster entry's existing_shares_face_with_character_key already describes — echo that roster entry's own character_key here instead of proposing a fresh-sounding duplicate. Omit when there is no such overlap.
